description: If zero equals one, a Boolean algebra is a singleton, has no ultrafilters, and its Stone map is a bijection onto the power set of the empty Stone space.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.trivial_representation.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (h : ⊥ = ⊤) :
  Subsingleton B ∧
    IsEmpty (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.StoneSpace B) ∧
      Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap
